source.method: Midwater trawl; net-in coordinates. Hauls are represented catch-table hauls, not a complete effort log.
limitations: Counts are specimens caught, not population counts or density. No tow effort or catchability correction is included.
Y is young-of-year/pelagic; A is older-than-YOY/post-settlement, not reproductive maturity. U is unknown.
Zero detection is assigned only for explicit zero rows in the selected species, stage and date filters.
Locations are trawl net-in points aggregated to authored 2 km cells, not fish GPS positions or NOAA DisMAP predictions.
Sampling months do not establish year-round seasonality. Adult blue rockfish habitat requires additional nearshore survey evidence.
